title: Vampire Vape Peppermint Rock 10ml E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Peppermint Rock 10ml E-Liquid is a true treat for the taste buds. If you can fondly remember the irresistible minty fruit candy crunch of this seaside treat then this exquisite Peppermint Rock Vampire Vape E-Liquid was meant for you. Fruity-sweet with mild floral background note, a rush of cool peppermint greets your palate on the exhale to create a delightfully nostalgic vape that you’ll want to return to again and again. If you have a sweet tooth don’t hesitate to give this Peppermint Rock by Vampire Vape E Liquid flavour a go, you won’t be disappointed. This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 0mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits . If you love this delicious Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. They have a multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour requirements. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverage, sweet bakery, confectionary and dessert flavours or even their classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours.
